**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

Section 2.1 (p0013) satisfies both preferred elements verbatim — no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and payment only for Services actually ordered, with non-ordering expressly not a breach or shortfall. Supporting terms: § 7.1 bars unidentified minimum-use charges, § 12.3 confirms no minimum-volume commitment, and § 9.4 gives Customer termination without cause with only accrued Fees owed and prepaid Fees refunded. No take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or usage cap exists anywhere in the document, so no redline was proposed.
